user_contract: Explicit fixed 3D polylines and tube mesh, independent of camera after export; GLB and OBJ
source_boundary: alpha>=0.5; exterior contours RETR_EXTERNAL; no internal holes or feature edges
anchor: Native top32 alpha*T contributions times previously frozen C-style support; contribution weighted original Gaussian-center camera-z is ONLY a depth proxy, not surface depth
fallback: If style mass is zero, use native alpha*T support; save fallback count and top32 mass
depth_filter: 5-sample median inside each source contour, applied before freezing once
line_creation: Lift ordered boundary pixels on calibrated source-camera rays using proxy depths; never connect Gaussian centers directly
breaks: Nonfinite/nonpositive depths or consecutive world step >8*(median source depth/focal*pixel stride)
tube_radius: 0.65 source pixel at median proxy depth; 8 sides
static_asset: Original world coordinates; no animation, billboards, camera-conditioned nodes, model weights or re-fitting needed
acceptance: Files parse as actual finite nonempty static mesh; serialization round-trip; source reprojection checked; no claim of multiview correct silhouette or recovered physical curve
scientific_status: Fixed 3D candidate export, single construction view, NOT a validated multiview curve recovery
protect: No base-model training or edits; writes only new stage; do not alter previous branches or protected credentials
